story_text: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking by its ID so that I can see its details.

positive.title: Retrieve a booking by a valid existing ID
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type the ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
positive.expected_result: The Booking details are retrieved successfully

positive.title: Retrieved booking contains all expected fields
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type the ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
positive.expected_result: The Booking details are retrieved successfully

negative.title: Retrieve a booking with a non-existent ID
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type a non-existent ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
negative.expected_result: An error prompting the user no available booking for this ID

negative.title: Retrieve a booking with an invalid ID format
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type an invalid ID format in the endpoint
3. Send the request
negative.expected_result: An error prompting the user no available booking for this ID

negative.title: Retrieve a booking with a missing ID
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Don't type the ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
negative.expected_result: An error prompting the user no available booking for this ID

negative.title: Retrieve another client's booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type the ID of a booking that is not yours in the endpoint
3. Send the request
negative.expected_result: An authorization error with staus code '401' or'403'

edge.title: Retrieve a booking using the ID of a cancelled booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type the cancelled booking ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
edge.expected_result: The Booking details are retrieved successfully

edge.title: Retrieve a booking using the ID of a confirmed booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type the confirmed booking ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
edge.expected_result: The Booking details are retrieved successfully

edge.title: Retrieve a booking using the ID of a pending booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the Get booking by ID endpoint
2. Type the pending booking ID in the endpoint
3. Send the request
edge.expected_result: The Booking details are retrieved successfully
